dialogues.speaker: Maison Gardiennage
dialogues.text: The Maison Gardiennage has recently received a number of reports, and discovered that the advertisements of many businesses have been defaced with defamatory comments, harming their businesses. This behavior is in flagrant violation of the relevant regulations of the Court of Fontaine regarding advertising boards.

dialogues.speaker: Maison Gardiennage
dialogues.text: The Maison Gardiennage has officially announced a warrant for their arrest, and is offering rewards to the public for any clues leading to an arrest. We expect that everyone will cooperate fully with our investigation.

dialogues.speaker: Intentionally Messy Handwriting
dialogues.text: "Hehe, what a bunch of blundering fools, not in this lifetime..."

dialogues.speaker: Maison Gardiennage
dialogues.text: The suspect was caught red-handed committing criminal acts at this very advertisement board, and has already confessed to all crimes. If there are any questions about the case, please contact the Maison Gardiennage. Notice is hereby given.
